data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 2.6m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2015: GBP 8.7m) arising predominantly from the nuclear liability class.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was GBP 34.662m. During 2016 the Syndicate released GBP 2.6m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods, arising predominantly from the nuclear liability class, resulting in a net prior-year release of approximately 7.5% of opening gross claims outstanding. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior year reserves are identified in the notes.

A gross claims development triangle is present on page 26 and was captured as a cross-check.
